titulo: Stay a while: the flat-pack hour
caption: YouTube only (a medio in 16:9, no Short and no Reel). What goes out is the YouTube title and the description.
descripcion:
A quiet 11-minute stretch for whoever is putting together a flat-pack shelf on the floor. No voice and no lecture. A clock runs from 4:12 p.m. on a Saturday and jumps ahead twice, short cards come and go, the afternoon light sinks in the window, and a drawn character, Cella, sits next to the box and does not touch a single piece. A screw is missing, and step nine undoes step six. Leave the video on or off whenever you want.

Somebody is on step nine tonight.

alt: An 11-minute video in 16:9 with no voice. A room late on a Saturday afternoon, seen at floor level: an open cardboard box, a few wooden boards lying on the floor, a small tray with screws, a window with the light going down slowly, a wall clock, a shelf frame that gains a part with each step, and Cella, a small blocky black figure with two round white eyes and no hands, sitting very still next to the box. A clock in the corner starts at 4:12 PM, runs one second per second, and jumps ahead to 4:40 and then to 5:05. Every 30 to 50 seconds a short card replaces the last one, such as The box is open, Stay a while, Lay out every part, Steps one to three, One screw is missing, Cella has not moved, Step nine and Something came off. At step nine one side of the shelf comes off. It ends on For whoever is on step nine, then Step nine undid step six, then Choose friction.
